name: Neural Duplex Radiance Fields (NDRF)
definition: A method to distill a pretrained NeRF into a mesh-based representation that enables real-time view synthesis. It overcomes inaccuracies in 3D surface reconstruction by learning aggregated radiance information from a reliable interval of ray-surface intersections (a 'duplex' interval) rather than a single surface point.
summary: Neural Duplex Radiance Fields distill NeRFs into mesh-based representations using a shallow CNN and two ray intersections to enable real-time view synthesis with 10,000 times faster performance.
